correctness.rationale: Shorting both leader vertices to ground makes the diagonal Dirichlet Green function the effective resistance to ground. On a tree a follower x projects to the leader-to-leader path, contributing branch resistance d(x,y) plus the parallel resistance AB/(A+B); summing yields six exact branch-symmetry orbit formulas. Independently computed rational grounded matrix inverse traces for every leader pair at k=3,4,5,6 and several t, total 171 inverses, and compared optimizing types. Symbolically check five strictly positive k=4 cost differences and nonnegative k-increments; for k=3 only inner-inner and center-leaf compete, with difference (t-1)(2t+1)/(2(t+1)); all four other types remain higher in the appropriate t-regime. Boundary t=1 is a genuine six-pair tie and no t<=0 is claimed. Finite checks corroborate, while resistance identity and factored inequalities establish all k and all real t>0.
